title: HMLAT-303, CAL FIRE combat California wildfires
description: A UH-1Y Venom with Marine Light Attack Helicopter Training Squadron (HMLAT) 303, Marine Aircraft Group 39, 3rd Marine Aircraft Wing, collects water from Lake O’Neil to support firefighters combating wildfires at Marine Corps Base Camp Pendleton, Calif., Oct. 18. HMLAT-303 supported firefighters with the California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (CAL FIRE) by dowsing brushfires which spread from northern Camp Pendleton earlier in the week. (U.S. Marine Corps photo by Lance Cpl. Robert Alejandre/Released)
